messages:
Maya: thinking out loud — proposing a small change to the onboarding pipeline: enrich bench signals with lightweight runtime-like probes before we run full benches. idea is a two-stage preflight: 1) smoke runner (fast, <30s) that captures latency p95, tokenization diffs, and kv-cache behavior; 2) scheduled full bench for perf/cost. :thinking:

Aj: love the idea. can you sketch what the smoke runner would actually run? single prompt, chat vs text?

Maya: smoke runner would run a canned set of 6 inputs: short chat, long context (~2k tokens), generate-with-stop, few-shot, embedding check, and a prefix-replay to exercise kv cache. keeps model warm and verifies outputs aren't obviously broken. expected runtime ~20s on a 4090.

Sam: tradeoff: doing kv-cache probes in preflight means we need runtime-like env to populate and reuse cache — that could be tricky for dedicated vs hosted. maybe simulate by replaying generation traces rather than full autogen?

Priya: suggestion: split runner into "stateless smoke" (tokenization, embedding parity, schema checks) and "kv probe" which is optional and gated to dedicated/private environments. that avoids spurious failures for hosted scaled-down workers.

Jason: question — how do we record the signals? we already have bench metrics in influx + eval logs. want a single compact artifact per model version that's cheap to store and fast to diff. maybe a JSON fingerprint with fields: tokenizer_hash, sample_output_hashes, p95_ms, kv_miss_rate?

Maya: exactly. propose artifact format v1: { "tokenizer": "sha256...", "samples": ["hash1","hash2"], "metrics": {"p95_ms":"120","p50_ms":"30","kv_reuse":"0.85"}, "runner_flags": ["kv_probe_enabled","quantized_8bit"]}

Aj: tiny nit — agents.md for storage says flat strings only, but for our system artifact can be JSON. we should compress + sign it, then upload to model-registry as metadata. ETag for quick comparison.

Sam: operational note — run the smoke runner as a k8s job with a 2m deadline. if kv_probe is enabled, schedule it on nodes with the same GPU topology to avoid false regressions from kernel differences.

Priya: gating rule proposal: require pass on stateless smoke and no catastrophic mismatches on samples to auto-admit. kv_probe failures should be advisory for hosted, blocking for Dedicated/Private. add a flake counter for transient infra flakes.

Jason: can we add a quick CLI to re-run the smoke runner locally? devs will want to replicate failures. something like `ri-smoke --model <id> --kv-probe`

infra-bot: created job ri-smoke-1748007654 in k8s namespace eng-ml-preflight, pod ri-smoke-1748007654-0 starting...

Maya: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC for artifact schema + gating rules, add a runbook for infra folks to request kv-probe nodes, and PR a minimal smoke runner (python) with the 6 canonical inputs. tagging @Sam @Priya for review. :+1:

Aj: sounds good, thanks Maya — happy to review the RFC and try the local CLI.

Sam: will look at node placement logic and add a fallback to a smaller kv probe that only does prefix-replay if full kv warmup isn't available.

Priya: can we add one quick metric: tokenization-length-delta to catch tokenizers that change split? saved us before. add to artifact.

Maya: added to notes. I'll post RFC link here when ready.
